name: shiksha-course-setup-tutorial
title: Draft a course with Course Companion

chapters.caption: 01  Use Create in the real Agentic Shiksha teacher workspace.
02  Give the course a name, then open Course Companion.
03  Describe the level, duration, code and learning goals.
04  Review the Companion's proposed fields in the actual course form.
05  Review the course description and prerequisites before choosing Create.
Draft only: this tutorial does not submit Create or provision a remote agent.

capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
